scripts.reset: aegir run clean && aegir clean interop/node_modules packages/**/node_modules node_modules package-lock.json packages/*/package-lock.json interop/*/package-lock.json
scripts.test:ci:part-1: aegir run test:cov --roots ./packages/utils/** ./packages/clients/peerbit ./packages/clients/test-utils ./packages/clients/vite ./packages/log -- --no-build && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @peerbit/react run test:cov && pnpm run test:ci:react-identity && pnpm run test:ci:react-sqlite-dev
scripts.test:react-identity: pnpm --filter @peerbit/react-e2e-browser... build && pnpm --filter @peerbit/react-e2e-browser exec playwright test tests/identity.spec.ts
scripts.test:ci:react-sqlite-dev: PEERBIT_E2E_VITE_DEV=1 pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @peerbit/react-e2e-browser exec playwright test tests/sqlite3-wasm.spec.ts
scripts.test:ci:part-4: aegir run test:cov --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- --no-build --grep "^(append delivery options|ReplicationDomainTime|checked prune|coordinate persistence|durable native block store restart|durable restart conformance|e2e|join|lifecycle( - getCover)?|network|observer|raw exchange-head sync|receive admission|refresh rejoin recovery|reopen native lifecycle|replicate|replication announcement retries|shared-log block publish adapter|strict live-range leader routing|sync-repair-session)"
scripts.test:ci:part-6: aegir run test:cov --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- --no-build --grep "^(adaptive ingest burst control|append(?! delivery options)|CPUUsageIntervalLag|debounceAcculmulatorMap|encryption|events|exchange heads|isLeader|load|migration-8-9|PIDReplicationController|ranges:|rateless-iblt-syncronizer|countAssignedHeads|countHeads|sync-chunking|sync-peer-state|sync-priority|waitForReplicator)" && pnpm --filter @peerbit/shared-log run benchmark:sync-peer-state:compare:test && aegir run test:cov --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log/proxy -- --no-build
scripts.test:ci:part-7: pnpm run test:ci:part-7a && pnpm run test:ci:part-7b && pnpm run test:ci:part-7c && pnpm run test:ci:part-7d && pnpm run test:ci:part-7e
scripts.test:ci:part-7a: aegir run test --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- -t node --no-build --grep "^u32-simple(?! replication degree)(?! sharding)"
scripts.test:ci:part-7b: aegir run test --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- -t node --no-build --grep "^u32-simple sharding distribution objectives memory"
scripts.test:ci:part-7d: aegir run test --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- -t node --no-build --grep "^u32-simple replication degree"
scripts.test:ci:part-7e: aegir run test --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- -t node --no-build --grep "^u32-simple sharding(?! distribution objectives memory)"
scripts.test:shared-log:chaos: aegir run test --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- -t node --no-build --grep "(control per commmit put before join converges under deterministic (delayed repair traffic|pubsub chaos)|survives deterministic delayed join and leave churn)"
scripts.test:shared-log:sharding-regression: aegir run test --roots ./packages/programs/data/shared-log -- -t node --no-build --grep "reproduces bounded prune convergence under delayed join traffic"
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run release:security-gate && node ./scripts/publish-public-packages.mjs
scripts.release:publish: pnpm run release && changeset tag && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:rc: pnpm run build && pnpm run release:security-gate && AEGIR_PACKAGE_MANAGER=pnpm aegir release-rc
scripts.release:security-gate: pnpm run test:release-security-contracts && pnpm run test:security-dependencies && pnpm run test:security-published-closure && pnpm run test:security-published && pnpm dlx pnpm@11.13.0 with current audit --prod --ignore CVE-2025-71330 --ignore CVE-2025-71329 && pnpm dlx pnpm@11.13.0 with current audit --ignore CVE-2025-71330 --ignore CVE-2025-71329
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm run site:build && pnpm run site:preflight && gh-pages --dist apps/peerbit-org/dist --dotfiles
scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p node_modules/chai-extend && cp chai-global.js node_modules/chai-extend/chai-global.js && echo '{"type": "module"}' > node_modules/chai-extend/package.json
scripts.coverage:report: pnpm run coverage:remap && pnpm run coverage:merge && nyc report --reporter=html --reporter=text
